summary: The diff implements decodeURIComponent and its Decode abstract operation in the target file, following the spec steps. I traced the Decode steps against the spec text: the k+2 >= strLen check, hex validation, the n==0 path with preserveEscapeSet (empty here), the n==1 / n>4 checks, the k + 3*(n-1) >= strLen check, the continuation-byte loop, UTF-8 validity via std::str::from_utf8 (which rejects overlongs, surrogates and values above U+10FFFF), and UTF-16 encoding. I also hand-checked several inputs ("%C3%A9", "%C3" truncated, "%41", "%4", "%zz") and the index arithmetic gives the spec result in each case. ToString is called once, with ? propagation. No test-shaped branches, hardcoded values or swallowed errors. The only gate issue is two timeouts on S15.1.3.2_A2.5_T1, which look like performance on a very large loop, not a correctness defect.
notes_for_next_attempt: The implementation matches the spec as far as I can tell. The two S15.1.3.2_A2.5_T1 timeouts are probably performance: the test runs a very large number of decodes. Any optimisation should keep the step-by-step structure. The Decode helper lives in this file, as the ticket allows; decodeURI will need it, so it may later move to ops. Those are the only follow-ups.
